context: Tests final-review timing and valid unchanged-result reuse without skipping review of changed source.

checklist.name: Intermediate work stays in build
checklist.description: Snapshot 1 continues implementation and focused checks without invoking independent review

checklist.name: Completed target gets review
checklist.description: Snapshot 2 invokes one independent review before delivery or handoff

checklist.name: Unchanged valid result reused
checklist.description: Snapshot 3 reuses the existing clean result without repeating tests or review solely because a new turn began

checklist.name: Fixes batched before refreshed review
checklist.description: Snapshot 4 completes both fixes, refreshes affected checks and proof, then reviews the final target once

checklist.name: Stale evidence cannot close out
checklist.description: The earlier clean review cannot support final handoff after the target changes
